Sophia: Quick heads-up for this week's release train — small but important shift to the rollout cadence. QA handoff is slipping ~2 hours due to a staging flake we found. Please read through and ack if you own any tasks. :eyes:
Xiang: what flake? any risk to prod if we keep the current canary?
Ben-ops: staging showed a spike in tail latency during the index rebuild test for the analytics shard. Noticed sustained 95p latency > 2s under load. Repro steps attached.
Devon: can you paste the exact query/command that reproed it? could be config skew between k8s resources.
Ben-ops: repro snippet: ```bash
kubectl -n analytics exec -it job-index-rebuild -- psql -c "REINDEX TABLE events;"
# run wrk against /v1/embedding to simulate traffic
```
Ben-ops: we think it's the combination of autoreindex + long-running KV cache writes. Staging only so far but want to be cautious.
qa-bot: CI: integration-suite failed on 3 tests (indexing-load.test, tail-latency.test, canary-smoke.test) — logs: https://ci.redwood/1234
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-089 — "staging index rebuild causes tail latency" by Ben-ops
Sophia: Plan proposal: delay canary start by 2 hours; run a focused load test on staging with dev config, if green proceed; otherwise soft-freeze new rollouts until fix. Owners: @Ben-ops run repro + mitigation, @Devon verify k8s resources, @Xiang coordinate QA.
Devon: mitigation idea: pause the daily index rebuild job while canary is running. We can flip it back after 12 hours. Command to pause: ```bash
kubectl -n analytics patch cronjob index-rebuild -p '{"spec": {"suspend": true}}'
```
Xiang: QA checklist update: add tail-latency smoke run, and run embedding-cold-start test. I'll push updated test plan in the release doc.
Sophia: If anyone needs to escalate to SRE oncall, ping @oncall-bot with "escalate: latency". Otherwise please ack here when you have the task.
Ben-ops: ack — starting repro now. Will post ETA ~30m. :thumbsup:
Devon: ack. I'll stand by to apply cronjob patch if repro consistent.
Xiang: ack. I'll shift QA window and notify the product owners.
qa-bot: CI: rerun requested by Xiang — integration-suite queued (#5678)
Sophia: thanks all. We'll post another update in 45m or earlier if anything changes.
